needs_manual_review_reason: NEW RECORD (2026-07-11). Two EGA study registrations exist for what is the same underlying project: EGAS00001003480 ('Mutational patterns and regulatory networks in epigenetic subgroups of meningioma') is confirmed live as an unreleased draft/stub registration (is_released=false, zero registered datasets, no linked PMID), while EGAS00001003481 (same title plus '(H033)' project-code suffix) is the canonical, released registration (pubmed_ids=[31069492] attached directly in the live EGA record) with two real datasets: EGAD00001005061 (WGS, 124 samples = 62 tumor/blood pairs from 62 patients, this record) and EGAD00001005021 (ChIP-seq, 16 samples). Per instructions this record uses EGAS00001003481/EGAD00001005061 as canonical and lists EGAS00001003480 in related_accessions as the duplicate/draft registration, not a separate record. The paper's abstract also describes RNA-seq added for 18 cases and ChIP-seq for 16 samples targeting the H3K27ac enhancer mark; no RNA-seq dataset is registered under either EGAS accession (only WGS and ChIP-seq are), so RNA-seq is not represented in this inventory from this study. UPDATE 2026-07-11 (centralized integration pass): a `chip_seq` modality value was added to docs/controlled_vocabulary.md specifically for EGAD00001005021 (the 16-sample H3K27ac ChIP-seq dataset from this same study), which is now folded into this record's own accessions/modality fields rather than left only in related_accessions, since it is part of the same integrated study and cohort. patient_count/sample_count above reflect only the WGS dataset (EGAD00001005061, 62 patients/124 samples); the ChIP-seq dataset's 16 samples are a further subset of the same cohort, not additional patients. The study description states the WGS cohort spans '40 sporadic and 22 radiation-induced (Mrad) meningiomas' and 'all MCs [6 methylation classes] and WHO grades', but the live /samples endpoint for EGAD00001005061 only exposes phenotype='Meningioma' for all 124 entries with no per-sample radiation-induced/sporadic or grade/methylation-class flag, so treatment_timepoint_status, grade_breakdown, and who_edition are left 'Not reported'/null here despite the aggregate description; the sporadic-vs-radiation-induced etiology distinction also does not map cleanly onto the existing treatment_timepoint_status controlled vocabulary (pre_radiation/post_radiation describe treatment timing, not radiation-induced tumor etiology), flagged for reviewer consideration. Only public EGA study/dataset-level metadata was used; the controlled-access sequencing data itself was never accessed, per docs/scope.md. AUDIT 2026-07-12 (external re-verification): sex_distribution added ('43 female, 19 male (62 patients)') from the live /datasets/EGAD00001005061/samples biological_sex field, exposed for all 124 WGS samples (86 female / 38 male at the sample level = 62 tumor/blood pairs) and internally consistent per subject_id, resolving to 43 female and 19 male across the 62 patients; previously 'Not reported'. patient_count (62), sample_count (124), ChIP-seq dataset EGAD00001005021 (16 samples), platform (Illumina HiSeq X Ten), pubmed_ids=[31069492] and all other fields re-verified correct against the live EGA API and PubMed this pass.
